name: opencode-content-pipeline
description: Two-step research-then-write pipeline that runs entirely on the OpenCode agent provider. OpenCode connects to its configured GitHub Copilot models, so the model ids are provider-qualified as 'github-copilot/<model>'.

steps.name: research
steps.systemPrompt: You are a meticulous research assistant. Produce a concise, well-structured brief with key facts and sources.
steps.userPrompt: Research the topic: {{param.topic}}. Summarize the most important points a writer would need.

steps.name: write-article
steps.systemPrompt: You are a content writer. Write clear, engaging prose grounded in the supplied research.
steps.userPrompt: Write a 400-word article about {{param.topic}} using the research above.

topic.description: The topic to research and write about
